name: Setsuna
source:
Youngest of the twins, Setsuna is the complete opposite of her sister: full of energy and wanting to do as much as possible in the shortest amount of time. Due to her hasty attitude, she makes a terrible housewife, and thus earns her keep by earning extra income as an aerobics instructor.

[From an [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070210175448/www.elizar.com/?p=29]old review[/url] by Nargrakhan]
